market_outlook.short_term: Bearish. S&P 500 on 4-day losing streak with oil at $105 and yields at multiyear highs creating a stagflationary pressure. Fed rate-hike bets intensifying. Expect continued volatility in equities, further bond selloff, and oil-driven inflation data. Apple iPhone launch provides isolated tech support but cannot offset macro headwinds. 1-3 month outlook: 5-8% downside risk for broad indices.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive. AI capex cycle (Google $15B, Oracle test) and defense spending provide structural growth. Energy transition (Sonnedix, renewables) and crypto maturation offer medium-term opportunities. However, sustained $100+ oil and higher-for-longer rates cap equity multiples. 6-12 month: expect range-bound markets with sector rotation from growth to value/energy/defense.
